headline: Mobile compatibility pages folded into one; AWS Control Tower BYOB onboarding corrected
summary_md:
- **Cortex XDR Compatibility Matrix** lost two pages: the Android and iOS/iPadOS tables now live on their parent page, taking the book from 15 pages to 13.
- Most compatibility tables were re-emitted as raw HTML with a single **Cortex XDR agent** header row over the version columns.
- **AWS Control Tower (BYOB) audit log collection** gained a CloudFormation parameter, a corrected IAM role name, and a post-deployment page retitled to cover it.
- **Microsoft Azure** automated collection now documents one management-group diagnostic setting instead of per-subscription ones.
- Nine pages lost their front-matter `description` blocks, and several XSOAR/XSIAM naming slips were fixed.

highlights.title: Android and iOS/iPadOS compatibility pages were deleted
highlights.detail: Both tables were merged into the parent mobile page, so bookmarks to the two child pages break and the compatibility book drops from 15 to 13 pages.

highlights.title: The Control Tower BYOB IAM role is named CloudTrailReadRole, not cortex-logs-ingestion-access-<suffix>
highlights.detail: Every occurrence in the cross-account KMS procedure changed, including the key-policy principal ARN a reader copies verbatim.

highlights.title: A LoggingAccountOuId parameter was added to the AWS authentication template
highlights.detail: It names the OU containing the Log Archive account, and the neighbouring SnsTopicOuId description no longer spells out the aws-controltower-AllConfigNotifications topic.

highlights.title: Azure management-group scope creates a single diagnostic setting
highlights.detail: Activity Logs propagate natively from child subscriptions through that one setting, and no per-subscription diagnostic setting is created.

highlights.title: XQL navigation is now Investigation & Response → Search → XQL Search
highlights.detail: The Query Builder → XQL step was removed from both query procedures, shortening each numbered list by one step.

highlights.title: Two internal links moved in opposite directions
highlights.detail: The ITDR Identity profile link was resolved from broken-reference to a real anchor, while the Windows agent release-notes link became broken-reference.

items.compatibility/where-can-i-install-the-co: Absorbs the Android and iOS/iPadOS tables, including the note that SMS filtering and call blocking work only on iPhones.
Deleted; its agent 9.1-8.8 support table now sits on the parent mobile page.
Deleted; its agent 9.1-8.8 support table and iPhone-only note now sit on the parent mobile page.
Intro rewritten around the kernel-module vs eBPF choice, and the kernel support link repointed to cortex-docs.paloaltonetworks.com/linux-kernel-versions.
Windows 10 and 11 tables drop the empty 7.9.103-CE column; the agent release-notes link is now broken-reference.
Platform table re-emitted as HTML with sub-OS rows nested, and the admin-guide link now points at an app.gitbook.com authoring URL.
Lead-in sentence and the Supported cloud platforms heading removed; only the HTML table remains.
Wording only: the FedRAMP note now reads "for Intel processors only" and the table's row label was blanked.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: Adds the LoggingAccountOuId CloudFormation parameter for the OU holding the Log Archive account.
The cross-account role is now CloudTrailReadRole everywhere, including the sample KMS key-policy principal.
Retitled to cover Custom (BYOB) and Control Tower; the KMS key-policy troubleshooting item is now Control Tower only.
Bucket lifecycle and retention are now described as customer-managed for custom Control Tower collection as well as BYOB.
Tenant and management-group scope now uses one management-group diagnostic setting rather than one per subscription.
items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: The dataset query procedure now starts at Search → XQL Search, dropping the separate Query Builder and XQL steps.
The Set up Identity Profiles link now resolves to the ITDR getting-started anchor instead of broken-reference.
